sup:DEMO-F1.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

As a family-run foundry, we deeply value our long relationship and take great pride in the dedication of our skilled team. In light of current market conditions, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. 

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €52.90 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our trustful cooperation and working together with you.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

reply.text:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and hold our Angebot. Our proposal remains set at a price of €51.80 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

We have not yet received your feedback on our last proposal. Over the years, our family foundry has valued the deep partnership we share with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH. Please let us know your thoughts so we can plan our production accordingly and ensure our dedicated craftsmen are prepared to serve you with the quality you expect from our region.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and hold our Angebot. Our proposal stands at a price of €51.80 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. 

Our family foundry takes great pride in the craft of our team and the longstanding relationship we have shared with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH over the years. We have not yet received your feedback on our last proposal. Please let us know if you need any further information from our side to proceed. 

Please note that our offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to hearing from you soon.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

Guten Tag,

as a family-run foundry with a long tradition in our region, we have always valued our shared history and the relationship with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH deeply. However, after careful consideration of the current situation, we must inform you that we are withdrawing from this negotiation. 

We thank you for the past conversations and wish your company all the best for the future.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

Guten Tag,
Many thanks for your message; I have read it carefully together with my people here at the foundry, and we have given it the attention it deserves.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €51.80 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026.
Let me tell you how we see it from our side.
We are willing to commit to the 24-month contract term you proposed to ensure long-term stability for both sides.
As a family-owned business, extending payment terms to 60 days is not feasible for our liquidity, so we must retain 30 days net.
Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net: €51.40 per unit.
Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms.
Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net.
Our standard terms apply to everything the quote does not state; see attached.
Please give my regards to your colleagues - a good relationship has always mattered more to us than a single order, and I hope it stays that way.
Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH
